arg.name: input
arg.description: The 2D results: ~/detections of the detection nodes, ~/faces of the face nodes or ~/output of the tracking nodes.

arg.name: depth
arg.description: The depth image registered to the color image of the 2D results (16UC1 in mm or 32FC1 in m), e.g. aligned_depth_to_color/image_raw of realsense2_camera.

arg.name: camera_info
arg.description: The camera info of the depth image.

arg.name: input_type
arg.description: Type of input: detections (DetectionArrayStamped), faces (FaceArrayStamped) or rects (RectArrayStamped).

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Queue size of the synchronized subscribers.

arg.name: roi_scale
arg.description: Scale of the 2D box whose depths are used, smaller to leave out the background at the edges of the box.

arg.name: depth_threshold
arg.description: The pixels within this distance (m) of the median depth of the box belong to the object.

arg.name: publish_tf
arg.description: Publish the TF frame tf_prefix + label_id of each object.

arg.name: track_distance
arg.description: An object within this distance (m) of an object of the same label in the previous images is the same object, and keeps its id.

arg.name: track_lost_frames
arg.description: Number of images that a lost object keeps its id for.
